answer: A bond of 49% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in garden, and lotus reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 200 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. Scaling to 675 identities multiplies that fee by 184 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
